blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The supplier of the proposed P470-million garbage-processing system for Cebu City has defended the apparent P220-million price gap raised during a City Council discussion, saying its earlier and latest offers carried the same price and processing capacity. Engineer Victoriano Ocon, president and CEO of Suki Trading Corp. and Vic Metal Fabrication and Environmental Services Inc., said the difference being discussed stemmed from the configuration of the proposed system, particularly whether garbage segregation would be done manually or through automated machines.
